title: Appending a value to a segment
statement: Let $\mu : \mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $l$ be a finite list of integers. If $\mu(a+i)=l_i$ for every index $i<|l|$, then changing the value of $\mu$ at $a+|l|$ to an integer $x$ makes it agree with the list obtained by appending $x$ to $l$, at every index starting at $a$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mu$ agrees with $l$ at every index in the segment starting at $a$
